title: Saint Catherine of Siena, Virgin and Doctor of the Church
short_summary: Saint Catherine of Siena is honored in the Dominican calendar as a virgin and Doctor of the Church whose life joined prayer, penance, charity, and courageous service to the Church.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps Saint Catherine of Siena as a feast on April 29.
The Order of Preachers identifies her as a virgin and Doctor of the Church.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says she was born in Siena in the Fontebranda district.
Her Dominican observance remains local or proper in the app and does not replace the general U.S. calendar day.

sections.heading: A Dominican Doctor
sections.body: Catherine's holiness was not separated from the Church's life. Her prayer and teaching served the Body of Christ with clarity, courage, and love.

sections.heading: Prayer and public witness
sections.body: Her life reminds the faithful that contemplation can bear fruit in concrete service, counsel, and reform when rooted in Christ.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Love for Christ and the Church
catholic_connection_sections.body: Catherine's witness holds together personal holiness and love for the visible Church, never treating them as rivals.
